theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_ims_imrep_of_int_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (m : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet N → N ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n N → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (N ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → StronglyMeasurable η → Measurable m → (∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, m x = z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
